title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC/24 > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF tracking via Audacity > FLAC/24 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: A stellar matrix recording captures a Norfolk show with high‑drama Scarlet>Fire and a funky Eyes of the World, though the performance runs hit‑or‑miss after a strong start.
ai_review.review: The matrix source is crystal‑clear, earning five stars for sound quality, while the concert itself gets an average three‑star rating. Highlights include the intense Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain segue and a mid‑tempo, Bowie‑like Eyes of the World, but later songs such as Alabama Getaway and CC Rider fall flat, and the set winds down hurriedly.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged around three stars (average) while recording quality receives five stars; weighted average yields ~3.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer praises the matrix mix as flawless, giving it five‑star sound quality with no noted issues.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert opens with high drama and tight transitions, then becomes uneven—some songs feel rushed or under‑cooked, culminating in a hurried close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers hypnotic arpeggio runs during Scarlet>Fire and recovers after a stumble on Eyes of the World; overall guitar work highlighted as high drama.
band_member_comments.Bob: Locks in with Jerry and Mydland during the intense Scarlet>Fire segment, but no specific comments beyond that.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart breaks a bass‑drum head early in set one; otherwise drumming is not specifically commented on.
